title: CS5351 team-app requirements registry
description: CI blocking gate 3 (project.pdf p10): the requirements registry must validate against this schema. See docs/req/req-registry-template.yaml for the field notes and vocabularies.

type.description: The seven requirement types named in project.pdf D1 p5.

statement.description: One sentence, 'shall' wording (checked loosely below so WRITING style like 'Shall' also passes).

fit_criterion.description: Machine-checkable criterion; NFRs are metric + threshold + verification. Numeric thresholds stay TBD until the baseline experiment is recorded.

priority.description: MoSCoW; the tradeoff for dropped/deferred entries is stated in source or an ADR.

status.description: Lifecycle; CI gates require tests + trace only for status=implement.

source.description: Origin of the requirement; requirements found by analysing the existing repository link their baseline evidence here.

cross_refs.description: Optional links: nfr / inv / adr / risk / fr / qr / sec / cost / performance keys, values are ID lists.
